$comment: Shared depth budgets. This file is the ONE place the quick/standard/exhaustive
budgets live; both runtimes take them from here. Edit THIS file, never either
runtime's source — the Python engine reads it directly at import, and the JS
build's block is GENERATED by tools/sync_tiers.py (run it, then commit).
Why this file exists: tier RULES were moved to contract/tiers.json in September
2026 after researchgate.net graded T4 in Python and T3 in JS. The budgets were
left behind as two hand-maintained literals and drifted the same way — audited
2026-09-15, `quick` verified 10 claims in Python and 14 in JS, which at 3 lenses
per claim is 30 agent calls against 42 for the same requested depth, undeclared.
The parity test could not see it: both files contain the token, so the row passed.
Key names are the Python engine's, so its call sites read this file unchanged;
the generator maps them to the JS build's camelCase names in one place.
`calibrate` is read only by the JS build — the Python CLI takes --calibrate/
DR_CALIBRATE instead — and is kept here so one file describes a whole depth.
lenses is 3 at every depth on purpose: 2 of N must refute to kill, so with 2
lenses a 1-1 split survives and no single lens can ever kill anything.
